plugins.name: claude-wayfinder
plugins.description: Helps Claude make deterministic, auditable choices about which agent and skills to use for a given task — replacing prose-scanning agent/skill selection with a typed scoring kernel.

plugins.name: claude-prospector
plugins.description: Claude Code efficiency and hygiene toolkit. Surfaces token spend across the 5h / 7d / Sonnet-7d billing windows with per-model / per-agent / per-skill attribution, and audits your effective Claude Code configuration (custom + plugin agents and skills) for overlap and conflicts. Ships an interactive dashboard, a conversational usage-analysis skill, and a structured config-audit skill.

plugins.name: claude-github-tools
plugins.description: GitHub workflow skills for Claude Code: structured issue creation, PR review-feedback triage, an unattended PR-feedback loop that drives a PR to green-and-merged, backlog summaries and quick-wins, milestone-grouped issue listings, and GitHub Actions authoring guidance. Works with an authenticated gh CLI; uses a configured GitHub MCP server when present and falls back to gh otherwise.

plugins.name: mini-caveman
plugins.description: Minimized, dependency-free, Claude-Code-only build of caveman (MIT, by Julius Brussee). Terse compressed responses (~65-75% fewer output tokens) via SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks, plus /caveman-help, a pure-Node isolated /caveman-compress, and the cavecrew subagents. Security-audited for work use.
